name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou: Tomoshibi ga Kienu Ma ni
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 灯火が消えぬ間に
source:
An injured young man suddenly takes refuge at the detective agency. Investigation of two cases becomes complex as they are gradually woven together.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Jing%C5%ABji_Sabur%C5%8D]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
一名受伤的年轻人突然逃进侦探事务所寻求庇护。两起案件的调查逐渐交织，局势也随之变得错综复杂。

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Jing%C5%ABji_Sabur%C5%8D]Wikipedia[/url]]
